Asset type: Apple App Store product-page Header for MixaFrame, a photo collage and layout app.

Input references: Image 1 is existing MixaFrame promotional artwork, use only its soft warm ivory background and subtle lavender/indigo visual identity, NOT its text or UI. Image 2 is the real jaguar photograph to preserve faithfully. Image 3 is the real toucan photograph to preserve faithfully.
Primary visual idea: individual wildlife photographs brought together into one beautiful photo composition. A refined clean editorial collage, not a wildlife landscape scene.
Design: warm ivory background with a very subtle lavender glow, delicate geometric frame lines at the far edges. Center a single low, wide rectangular collage with crisp white borders and thin white gutters, containing a larger jaguar photo on the left and a smaller toucan photo on the right; both faces clearly recognizable and photo-real. Constraints: no text anywhere, no letters, no app icon, no logos, no badges, no watermark, no phone/tablet/device frames, no fabricated UI or buttons, no unrelated objects, no collage spanning the entire canvas. Preserve the jaguar face and toucan beak from the references. Avoid clutter and heavy 3D effects. This is a finished production banner, not a mockup or a contact sheet.
